summary: Antique representative with 72 principal-authored bills. Authored living wage standards and a petroleum tax suspension during crisis. Co-authored the national minimum wage, income tax restructuring, abolition of the corporate minimum tax, travel-tax abolition and anti-dynasty bills.
caveat: Tax co-authorships point right, the wage bills left; net is modest. Anti-dynasty is a single institutions issue and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored living wage standards (-3) and co-authored the national minimum wage (-2), offset by a petroleum tax suspension (+1) and co-authored abolition of the corporate minimum tax (+2) and travel tax (+1).
